purpose: Connect articles to a factual bilingual author profile and make private search snapshots readable offline.
publication: Draft only. Approval of PR69/70 does not approve this new work. Refresh profile modification date if changed on publication.

scope.fallbackForOtherLanguages: English profile with an explicit English language attribute.
scope.searchReport: Offline existing-snapshot text output; no API calls, authentication or file writes.

review.type: Self AI review of paired copy, source-supported identity, structured data and generated output; browser screenshots.

findings.issue: A richer author page could invent credentials or claim all articles are verified.
findings.resolution: Use only the existing account/repository identity and subject scope. Explain AI assistance and scoped checks; add no title, employment, awards or claimed expertise.

findings.issue: Introducing about links in eight languages could create unavailable local pages.
findings.resolution: Create only English/Korean routes. Other editions link to the English page and declare its language.

findings.issue: The new footer link can exceed a narrow screen.
findings.resolution: Allow footer links to wrap and verify at320/390/1280px.

findings.issue: A readable search report could reveal private queries or turn missing values into zeroes.
findings.resolution: Render only URL inspection fields, site totals and transition counts. Omit query rows and distinguish missing data/API errors. Report mode cannot combine with live collection flags.

validation.offlineReport: Existing30-URL private baseline rendered without API/authentication/file writes; timestamp retained and query rows omitted.

limits: Draft pages are not public until approval.
Schema consistency is locally checked; no Google Rich Results validation or ranking effect is claimed.
The saved baseline is not a fresh indexing observation.
No recurring task or automatic publication is configured.
